the use of fuzzy logic methods in the control of electromechanical objects is an effective and promising direction of research.
the use of fuzzy logic in the control systems of electromechanics is a very promising direction in the development of the theory of automatic control.

the use of fuzzy logic in control systems of technical devices has a significant advantage, which is due to the possibility of taking into account a number of factors, the values of which cannot be determined with sufficient accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fuzzy logic is a powerful tool for the design of intelligent control systems for electromechanical plants, which can be successfully applied to solve various control problems.
fuzzy logic is a promising method of solving the problem of control of electromechanical objects.

fuzzy logic control methods are widely used in the control of technical plants, and they have the following advantages: they allow to solve problems of control of plants with unknown, or not determined or strictly nonlinear mathematical model, with nonlinear disturbances; they are effective in solving problems of control of complex technical systems, in which the control of individual elements is carried out using different methods; in the design of fuzzy controllers, the expert approach is used; they allow to solve control problems of plants with a high level of uncertainty
The main takeaway from our work is that
fuzzy logic methods are widely used in the control systems of electromechanics.
the fuzzy logic approach is a powerful tool in the design of control algorithms, especially in the case when the mathematical model of the controlled plant is not known or is too complicated.
the fuzzy logic methods are applicable to a wide range of control problems, and their effectiveness has been proven by many experiments with various electromechanical devices.
